modal.title: Tutu the Elephant
modal.subtitle: Terre des hommes
modal.overview: Tutu is the Terre des hommes mascot, here to welcome you to the Youth Innovations Marketplace. Walk the hall, visit all 20 satellite booths, and learn what youth teams have been building across the region.

modal.title: The VEWU Lighthouse
modal.subtitle: Violence Ends With Us
modal.overview: The Lighthouse is the guiding light of Violence Ends With Us — a youth-led movement across the Asia-Pacific whose members call themselves Lightkeepers. It stands beside the VEWU booth to guide you through the Marketplace: collect passport stamps, watch the booth TVs, try the quizzes, and leave a pledge on the Commitment Wall. I am the LIGHT — it's time for you to shine.
